payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_rebut.py::test_a_lens_named_unreviewed_gets_no_verdict_session_and_keeps_its_numbers stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/phases/rebut.py. The claim was "`rebut.run_rebut` takes a keyword `unreviewed`, a collection of lens names that defaults to empty. A lens it names gets no verdict session. Every other lens holding a blocker still gets its own. The rebuttal turn's prompt still carries every blocker, and every blocker keeps the number its place in `blockers` gives it. So a guarded blocker a healthy lens withdraws is still refused under its own number. The witness names `adequacy` alone in a list, `correctness` alone in a tuple, `correctness` and `contract` in a set, and `correctness`, `contract` and `adequacy` in a list. In each case but the last, the lens left to verdict is `correctness` or `adequacy`. `conventions` holds no blocker in the witness.".
